What is geoaeo?

geoaeo makes any site quotable by AI answer engines, so a page that opens with a direct answer can be cited.

Answer engines do not rank a whole document the way classic search does. They pull a passage and attribute it. That only works when the page has a clear heading, an opening sentence that states the claim, and enough body text after the lede for the engine to quote. A heading plus one short sentence is not a source. It is a stub.

The audit already extracts visible page text, so the check can count words on a string that exists instead of parsing the document a second time. A citation-oriented floor sits below the classic 150-word SEO cutoff because the goal is a passage to quote, not a long article. One quote-length block plus a short supporting paragraph is enough. A page that only opens well and then stops is not.

This fixture is the substantial case. It keeps the same opening shape as the thin page and then adds the body an engine would actually cite. If answerability passes here and fails on the thin sibling, the word-count half is doing the job the check is named for.
